body.condition:
\[
\mathbb E_P\!\left[
B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\,\middle|\,
(X_{s't'})_{1\le s'\le S,\,1\le t'\le T},E_0
\right]
=\mathbb E_P[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid E_0]
\quad\text{for every }s,i.
\]

novel.justification: This is an explicit strong full-design strict-exogeneity restriction preventing design-measurable event components from surviving cross-unit averaging; conditional cross-unit independence does not imply it.
